label: Weak, dense hum that rises on mental-health care vocabulary: words naming the field or its professions (psychiatrist, psychiatric, psychologist, psychology, 'mental health') and words for talking-cure care (therapy, talk therapy, counselling, sharing feelings in group sessions). Plain diagnoses (depression, anxiety) and therapy acronyms (CBT) stay low. Known side channels: the word ' talking' even outside care (a talking parrot ~0.3) and ' therapy' in non-psychiatric senses (speech therapy ~0.45); ordinary medical scenes hum at 0.1-0.4, so it is a weak preference, not a clean switch.
